profile.headline: Sr Staff Software Engineer at Dexcom
profile.summary:
I’m an iOS Engineer with more than 10 years of experience building mobile applications that are reliable, scalable, and designed with the user in mind. Over the course of my career, I’ve worked primarily with Swift and the modern Apple ecosystem, delivering products in industries such as health, sports, and connected devices.

My work focuses not only on implementing features, but on designing maintainable systems and making thoughtful technical decisions that support long-term product growth. I’ve contributed to both new applications and mature products, helping evolve architectures, improve performance, and ensure codebases remain clean and sustainable over time.

I take an active role across the entire development lifecycle — from technical design and architecture to implementation, testing, and delivery. Collaboration is a key part of how I work, and I enjoy partnering with cross-functional teams to turn ideas into well-crafted products.

I’m particularly interested in connected technologies and mobile systems that interact with hardware, including devices communicating through Bluetooth Low Energy. I enjoy solving complex problems and continuously improving both the products I work on and the way I work as an engineer.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead for the combined iOS organization responsible for Dexcom’s primary mobile platforms: Dexcom G7, Dexcom ONE+, and Dexcom Flex, used globally for continuous glucose monitoring.

• Lead technical strategy and architectural direction across multiple iOS applications within an FDA-regulated medical device ecosystem.

• Coordinate development across teams to deliver reliable, high-quality software supporting millions of users worldwide.

• Drive engineering standards, platform consistency, and long-term maintainability across shared mobile infrastructure.

• Partner with product, backend, QA, and regulatory teams to ensure safe, compliant, and scalable product delivery.

• Mentor engineers and guide technical decision-making across the iOS organization.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key contributor to the development of the Dexcom G7 and Dexcom ONE iOS application, helping build the next-generation platform for continuous glucose monitoring.

• Designed and implemented core features for the G7 mobile application from early development through global launch.

• Contributed to architecture and platform capabilities supporting scalability and long-term product evolution.

• Worked on parallel initiatives including Dexcom ONE and Dexcom ONE+, extending the platform across multiple product lines.

• Focused on reliability, performance, and maintainability within a regulated medical software environment.
positions.insights: iOS development, Medical Devices and +2 skills

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked across two generations of Dexcom mobile applications supporting diabetes management.

• Maintained and improved the Dexcom G5 iOS application, focusing on stability, bug resolution, and testing improvements.

• Contributed to feature development and product readiness for the Dexcom G6 mobile application.

• Helped strengthen testing practices and release quality for mobile software operating within an FDA-regulated medical device ecosystem.

projects.title: Easton Power Sensor
projects.description:
Train Like a Pro — Improve Your Game
The Easton Power Sensor was designed to help players of all abilities improve their swing to hit with more power and efficiency.  It slips over the knob of any regulation baseball or softball bat and has been designed to capture highly accurate swing metrics and deliver advanced performance analysis.  The Easton Power Sensor features Blast Motion’s patented Smart Video Capture™ technology, allowing the mobile app to intelligently combine video and swing metrics to create a powerful new swing analysis tool that automatically detects a player’s swing and clips the video to create a series of video highlights. No user editing or playback intervention is required to experience this groundbreaking functionality, and the video highlights can be shared with metrics to social media, coaches, friends, or parents with one touch.

Designed in collaboration between Easton Baseball / Softball and Blast Motion, the Easton Power Sensor places the power of swing science in your hands.

projects.title: Implementation of a Facial Recognition Algorithm for a Home Automation System [Spanish]
projects.description: Development of a face recognition system using OpenCV libraries in Python, using a Raspberry Pi 2 as a development platform. The project implements a "smart" lock able to recognize authorized users by a facial recognition algorithm.
